name: write_countdown_sequence_to_memory

name: run_blit_from_entry_list

name: copy_table_entries_into_list

name: draw_packed_number_glyphs

name: dispatch_channel_command_by_nibble

name: add_nibble_clamp_to_max

name: step_audio_channel_sequence

name: load_audio_channel_entry
